name: chromiumoxide-extension
description: Lets chromiumoxide drive the browser you already use.

scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox && wxt build -b safari --mv3
scripts.package:safari: wxt build -b safari --mv3 && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter .output/safari-mv3 --project-location .output/safari-xcode --app-name chromiumoxide --bundle-identifier com.garysomerhalder.chromiumoxide --macos-only --no-open --force
